brief: Compare starting contributions earlier or later under the same explicit projection assumptions.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Contribution Time"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Tiempo para aportar"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Tempo para aportar"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Compare starting contributions earlier or later under the same explicit projection assumptions.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Compare fictional projections in dollars with the same assumptions; starting later leaves fewer contribution periods.
instruction.misconception: Starting later produces the same projected result without changing contributions, timing or assumed growth.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: Earlier deposits add contribution periods and time for assumed growth. A projection illustrates assumptions; it does not guarantee future returns.
Earlier contributions have more periods in this stated model.
The start date changes deposits and time in the model.
Starting earlier adds a deposit and its assumed growth.
An illustration cannot guarantee the assumed future path.
Different deposits and returns prevent isolating the start-date effect.
More contribution periods matter even without growth in this model.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
